status: DRAFT-NOT-FROZEN (compiled against profile-v1-DRAFT/B4-broad; not a frozen profile)
claim_scope: Rejection codes are compiler outcomes over the original normalized graph: a code says only that this graph carries something the DRAFT bundle/image format cannot express completely. A rejection is NEVER a fidelity or quality judgment, and a compile is NEVER a support claim. Rejections never trim: the compiler emits either a complete image or a rejection record, never a reduced image.
rules: Every emitted code must exist in this catalog (fail-closed: an uncataloged code aborts the compile).
One graph can carry several codes; outcome precedence: unresolved > rejected. There is no outcome that keeps part of a patch.

Adaptation-class codes (polylimit/unison reduction) reject the compile of the ORIGINAL graph; an adapted preset becomes compilable only through a future explicit adaptation path with its own visible record, never by silent edit at compile time.
Codes shared with SXT-017 keep the SXT-017 name and meaning so compile outcomes reconcile with reports/sxt-017/predictions/.

codes.meaning: The source census entry did not normalize (SXT-011 analysis_failure); there is no graph to compile.
codes.gate: input line st != 'normalized' or missing g

codes.meaning: Scene-mode id outside the engine-declared set {0,1,2,3}; the SXT-015 model refuses to account the structure.
codes.gate: accounting scene-mode check

codes.meaning: The declared event-timing requirement exceeds the model event queue depth; image event-timing section could not be closed.
codes.gate: SXT-015 event profile vs event_queue_depth

codes.meaning: The graph carries MSEG/Formula LFO records whose curve contents are not exported by surgepy (SXT-011 exposure gap). An image without the curves would be implicitly trimmed, so the graph cannot be compiled today.
codes.gate: SXT-011 data-gap policy mseg_formula_lfo_contents=unresolved

codes.meaning: An oscillator slot's normalized type is Audio Input: the patch depends on the external audio input path, which is outside the DRAFT bundle.
codes.gate: g.dep contains 'audio_input'

codes.meaning: The graph's scene mode is outside the bundle's declared scene_modes. (Dormant under B4-broad, which declares all scene modes; live under narrower bundles.)
codes.gate: g.sm in bundle spec scene_modes

codes.meaning: An active oscillator slot's engine family (display name) is outside the bundle's oscillator allowlist.
codes.gate: active osc slots vs bundle oscillator_allowlist

codes.meaning: An active oscillator slot's submode (p[0]) is outside a bundle-declared submode allowlist. Dormant under the DRAFT bundle spec schema, which declares no per-family submode gate (filter_subtypes policy is engine_declared_set and the oscillator allowlist is family-level); the code exists so a future submode gate gets a distinct, stable code instead of overloading the family code. Adding the gate itself is a bundle-spec revision (visible contract revision).
codes.gate: reserved; not evaluable under schema sxt-017-bundle-spec/1.0.0

codes.meaning: An active oscillator needs wavetable assets but the bundle declares wavetable_assets=false. (Dormant under B4-broad, which declares true.)
codes.gate: active wavetable osc slots vs bundle wavetable_assets

codes.meaning: An active filter unit's type is outside the bundle's filter_type_allowlist. (Dormant under B4-broad, which declares 'all'.)
codes.gate: active filter units vs bundle filter_type_allowlist

codes.meaning: A scene carries an active waveshaper but the bundle's waveshaper_policy is 'none'. (Dormant under B4-broad, which declares 'all'.)
codes.gate: waveshaper_active scenes vs bundle waveshaper_policy

codes.meaning: An ENABLED FX instance's class is outside the bundle's fx_type_allowlist. Per-slot fxd-disabled slots hold state but gate nothing (SXT-015 rule).
codes.gate: enabled FX instances vs bundle fx_type_allowlist

codes.meaning: An ENABLED Airwindows instance selects an algorithm id outside the bundle's selected set (B4: top-12 by preset coverage).
codes.gate: enabled Airwindows p[0] vs bundle airwindows_policy

codes.meaning: More ENABLED FX instances than the bundle's fx_instance_limit. Two Delay slots are two instances; the limit is per instance, never per distinct type.
codes.gate: enabled instance count vs bundle fx_instance_limit

codes.meaning: The stored polylimit exceeds the bundle's scene-voice pool; playing at full stored polyphony needs a disclosed polyphony reduction. The compiler rejects the original graph (adaptation is a separate explicit path).
codes.gate: g.poly vs bundle voice_pool_limit (poly_gate=adapted_beyond_pool)

codes.meaning: An active oscillator's effective unison exceeds the bundle's unison cap; needs a disclosed unison reduction. (Dormant under B4-broad, whose cap equals MAX_UNISON=16.)
codes.gate: max effective unison vs bundle unison_cap

codes.meaning: Modeled on-chip state exceeds the bundle's on-chip RAM budget. Basis: SXT-015 placeholder state model [PENDING-SXT-016].
codes.gate: allocations on_chip total vs bundle budgets.on_chip_ram_bytes

codes.meaning: Modeled external writable state exceeds the bundle's external writable budget. Long delay/reverb buffers live in external writable memory; flash is never a substitute.
codes.gate: allocations external total vs bundle budgets.external_writable_bytes

codes.meaning: Modeled external traffic at 48 kHz exceeds the bundle's bandwidth budget. Basis: SXT-015 placeholder bandwidth [PENDING-SXT-016].
codes.gate: allocations ext bytes/s vs bundle budgets.external_bandwidth_bytes_per_s

codes.meaning: A wavetable asset record has neither embedded bytes nor a resolved file (SXT-011 records the engine's default-table fallback). An image cannot reference the missing asset; emitting one would silently substitute the engine default for the preset's own table. SXT-020 compiler gate: stricter than the SXT-017 predictor, which has no image to emit.
codes.gate: g.wta records with neither emb>0 nor res

codes.meaning: An ENABLED FX instance occupies send slot 3 or 4 (roles send3/send4), but scene send levels for buses 3/4 are not exported by SXT-011 (the binding exposes send_level[0..1] only; buses 3/4 run at loader defaults). The image cannot express the complete send routing; emitting one would implicitly trim the patch. SXT-020 compiler gate: stricter than the SXT-017 predictor, which has no image to emit.
codes.gate: enabled FX slots with role send3/send4

codes.meaning: An FX slot carries a routing form the image format cannot express: a role string outside the engine's 16-role set, or a role/slot-index inconsistency. Never observed in the committed corpus; exists so malformed or future graphs fail closed instead of compiling into a wrong routing.
codes.gate: fx slot role in engine role set; role/slot-index consistency

declared_non_gates: Oscillator submodes (p[0] of every family), filter subtypes, and waveshaper algorithms are carried verbatim in the image and are NOT gated: the DRAFT bundle declares no submode/algorithm-level allowlists (filter_subtypes policy = engine_declared_set). Closing any of these is a visible bundle-spec revision (profile-v1-DRAFT section 8 trigger 6).

Cycle closure is NOT a gate: every cycle number is SXT-015 placeholder-v0 [PENDING-SXT-016]; cycles are published as image allocation columns only (bundle budgets.cycle_closure = not_gated_pending_sxt_016).

fx_bypass section state (fxb) and per-slot fxd disable bits are patch content carried in the image; a patch whose FX are bypassed is compiled as stored (the state is the patch), not rejected and not rewritten.
